answer: An agent may wander between trading aliases, but the reward vault pays only once per factory-certified chip per epoch. A claim signs the epoch and payout key; validators reject a second claim carrying the same chip certificate. Require a nonexportable signing key, since a cipher on a copyable file cannot prevent clones. Extra aliases earn nothing without extra genuine chips, so an attacker must buy hardware per reward slot. This assumes one certificate per chip and an honest issuer.
